summary_zh:
這是北邊知名的瀑布，他有東、西兩側，皆可免費停車，建議可以先到西側，旁邊有休息中心，可以用餐，買東西，付費廁所。

這個瀑布有「東、西」兩側，我建議先停在加油站、休息中心這一邊，步行前往觀看後，有時間再從加油站旁的鐵橋，步行到另一側。

無論你停哪一邊，皆可以步行的方式走到對面。
summary_en: This well-known northern waterfall has both east and west sides, each offering free parking. I recommend starting at the west side, where there is a rest center with dining options and a paid restroom. Park near the gas station and rest center, then walk to the viewing area. If you have time, you can cross the nearby iron bridge to explore the east side on foot. Regardless of which side you choose, you can easily walk to the opposite side.
